suggestions.name: National Institute for Educational Professional Development (NIEPD / المعهد الوطني للتطوير المهني التعليمي)
suggestions.focus: Government body established 2019 responsible for teacher and school-leader professional development across all public education; designs CPD pathways, licensing preparation programs, and cross-sector educator upskilling aligned with Vision 2030

suggestions.name: Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS / الهيئة السعودية للتخصصات الصحية)
suggestions.focus: National independent commission overseeing accreditation, postgraduate training programs, continuous professional development, and competency-based assessment for all health professions; designs curricula and examination frameworks for 38+ residency and diploma programs

suggestions.name: Saudi Arabian Drilling Academy (SADA)
suggestions.focus: Non-profit sector-specific technical and academic training academy (Saudi Aramco / TVTC partnership) offering diploma apprenticeship programs in drilling, well-control, and upstream energy operations; employs curriculum designers, simulation instructors, and HSE educators

suggestions.name: Higher Institute for Paper and Industrial Technologies (HIPIT / المعهد العالي للتقنيات الورقية والصناعية)
suggestions.focus: Non-profit TVTC-supervised technical training institute offering two-year diploma programs in industrial mechanics, industrial electricity, paper production and packaging, and supply chain management for Saudi high school graduates entering the manufacturing sector

suggestions.name: Classera
suggestions.focus: Saudi-founded edtech company (est. 2012) providing an AI-powered Learning Management System and Training Management System serving K-12 schools, universities, and corporate training clients across KSA and 40+ countries; roles in instructional design, content development, and educational technology

suggestions.name: Aanaab (أناب)
suggestions.focus: Saudi edtech platform (est. 2016/2019) dedicated to K-12 teacher professional development; offers Arabic-language courses in pedagogy, assessment, curriculum, and AI-in-education; provides Cambridge-certified credentials and school-leader preparation for Saudi teacher licensing exams

suggestions.name: Saudi Mining Polytechnic (SMP)
suggestions.focus: Non-profit vocational training institute (Ma'aden–TVTC partnership) qualifying Saudi youth for technical roles in mining, cement, and associated industries; curriculum includes chemistry, safety, and geosciences

suggestions.name: Elaa Academy (Royal Commission for AlUla)
suggestions.focus: Vocational and professional development academy for tourism, hospitality, heritage-site management, and destination experience; workforce training arm of the Royal Commission for AlUla

suggestions.name: Maarif for Education & Training
suggestions.focus: Saudi Arabia's largest private K-12 school operator (60+ schools across the Kingdom under Manarat, Al-Faisaliah, Green Hills, Nour Al-Islam, and GEMS brands); national and international (IB/IGCSE) curricula; significant need for science and STEM educators

suggestions.name: King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre (KFSH&RC) — Education & Training Division
suggestions.focus: Academic medical centre with a dedicated Education and Training Office (est. 1976) running postgraduate medical education, simulation-based training, allied health CPD, and continuing medical education; ranked #1 MENA academic medical centre

suggestions.name: YNMO (ينمو)
suggestions.focus: Saudi edtech and rehabilitative-technology platform providing AI-driven educational and therapeutic programs for children with disabilities and special needs; partners with educational and governmental institutions across the GCC; relevant to special/inclusive education with a STEM-accessibility angle

suggestions.name: Taawoni (تعاوني)
suggestions.focus: Saudi edtech startup (founded 2021) automating cooperative training (co-op) programs and AI-powered professional development, connecting universities and employers; supports curriculum design, internship workflows, and learning & mentorship platforms across industries

suggestions.name: Inaya Medical Colleges
suggestions.focus: Private allied health sciences college offering undergraduate programs in clinical laboratory sciences, biomedical technology, nuclear medicine, radiological science, nursing, and health informatics — relevant to foundation-year science teaching and health sciences education faculty roles

suggestions.name: ITQAN — Inspection Technology and Quality Assurance National Institute
suggestions.focus: Not-for-profit technical training institute (Saudi Aramco / TVTC partnership) offering inspection and quality assurance diplomas for the energy sector — relevant to science/technical instruction and curriculum roles in industrial vocational education

suggestions.name: International Schools Group (ISG)
suggestions.focus: Not-for-profit network of five international schools (American School Dhahran, British School Dhahran, ISG Dammam, ISG Jubail, Sara Village School) offering US/British/IB curricula PK–12 — active recruiter for science, STEM, and curriculum development educators

suggestions.name: IMC Medical College (International Medical Center)
suggestions.focus: New private medical college (announced 2024) attached to IMC Hospital offering Medicine, Nursing, and Master's in Public Health programs — relevant to health sciences education, anatomy/physiology instruction, and medical curriculum design

suggestions.name: EnergyTech (formerly Saudi Petroleum Services Polytechnic — SPSP)
suggestions.focus: Rebranded energy-sector vocational polytechnic (Ministry of Energy / TVTC / Saudi Aramco / Chevron partnership) delivering NVQ-accredited petroleum, drilling, and energy technology training — relevant to technical science instruction, curriculum design, and L&D roles in the energy education niche

suggestions.name: EtonHouse International Education Arabia
suggestions.focus: Singapore-based international school group operating inquiry-based early years and primary campuses in Riyadh — actively recruits science, STEM, and early-childhood educators; distinct from the generic 'British/American international schools' cluster already listed

suggestions.name: AlGooru (القورو)
suggestions.focus: Saudi Arabia's first NELC-licensed private tutoring platform offering 1-on-1 academic tutoring for K-12 and university students across 20+ subjects, including sciences; hires tutors, curriculum content specialists, and education technology staff

suggestions.name: National Center for School Evaluation and Excellence (Tamayuz — تمايز)
suggestions.focus: ETEC-affiliated center responsible for school accreditation, curriculum evaluation, national student performance assessment (NAFS), and AI-powered school evaluation tools (Ada'una); a distinct employer from ETEC and Qiyas already listed

suggestions.name: National Center for Training Evaluation and Accreditation (Masar — مسار)
suggestions.focus: ETEC-affiliated body that accredits vocational and technical training programs nationwide, sets training quality standards, and validates training institutions against labor-market benchmarks under Vision 2030

suggestions.name: Naseej International Trading Co. (نسيج)
suggestions.focus: Saudi-headquartered EdTech/IT company (est. 1989) providing LMS platforms, campus management systems, library management, e-learning solutions, and knowledge management services to higher education institutions and knowledge centers across the Arab world; hires instructional technologists, e-learning specialists, and education systems analysts

suggestions.name: Saudi Red Crescent Authority — General Directorate of Academic Affairs and Training (هيئة الهلال الأحمر السعودي — الإدارة العامة للشؤون الأكاديمية والتدريب)
suggestions.focus: Runs first-aid, emergency medical, and community health-education training programs (including the Life Ambassador First Aid Program) for citizens, health professionals, and school staff across all Saudi regions; a distinct training/education employer in the healthcare-education nexus

suggestions.name: King Salman Energy Park (SPARK) — Training Zone (مدينة الملك سلمان للطاقة — منطقة التدريب)
suggestions.focus: Industrial city managed by Saudi Aramco containing ten specialized energy-sector training centers focused on vocational workforce development in petrochemicals, drilling, firefighting/industrial safety, and energy technologies; offers vocational training programs aligned with Vision 2030 energy-sector localization goals
